WITH release_movies AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT mi.movie_id
    FROM movie_info AS mi
    JOIN info_type AS it2 ON it2.id = mi.info_type_id
    WHERE it2.info = 'release dates'
),
rating_movies AS (
    SELECT miidx.movie_id,
           MIN(miidx.info) AS info
    FROM movie_info_idx AS miidx
    JOIN info_type AS it ON it.id = miidx.info_type_id
    WHERE it.info = 'rating'
    GROUP BY miidx.movie_id
),
production_movies AS (
    SELECT mc.movie_id,
           MIN(cn.name) AS name
    FROM movie_companies AS mc
    JOIN company_name AS cn ON cn.id = mc.company_id
    JOIN company_type AS ct ON ct.id = mc.company_type_id
    WHERE cn.country_code = '[us]'
      AND ct.kind = 'production companies'
    GROUP BY mc.movie_id
)
SELECT MIN(production_movies.name) AS producing_company,
       MIN(rating_movies.info) AS rating,
       MIN(t.title) AS movie
FROM title AS t
JOIN kind_type AS kt ON kt.id = t.kind_id
JOIN release_movies ON release_movies.movie_id = t.id
JOIN rating_movies ON rating_movies.movie_id = t.id
JOIN production_movies ON production_movies.movie_id = t.id
WHERE kt.kind = 'movie'
